nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set in constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
Caller address controlled by external actor; used in constructors, modifiers and callback authentication.
Constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
OnlyOwner function that reassigns the owner state variable to newOwner.
Address parameter of transferOwnership, assigned into owner.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded body.
OnlyOwner function that sets the bankAddress state variable.
Address parameter of setBank, written into bankAddress.
OnlyOwner function that sets the updaterAddress state variable.
Address parameter of setUpdaterAddress, written into updaterAddress.
View function comparing updaterAddress.balance against requestPrice.
OnlyOwner function that sets the requestPrice state variable.
Uint256 parameter of setPrice, written into requestPrice.
OnlyBank external function that starts a rate query and stores updateTime/waitQuery.
Oracle callback guarded by msg.sender == updaterAddress && waitQuery; stores rate and callbackTime.
Uint256 callback payload assigned into the rate state variable.
Payable fallback that forwards msg.value to updaterAddress via transfer.
updaterAddress.transfer(msg.value) external value transfer executed in the fallback function.
Latest oracle rate value set by the callback.
Address of the oracle updater wallet; receives fallback funds and authenticates callbacks.
Address of the bank contract authorised to call updateRate.
Boolean flag tracking whether a query is pending.
Timestamp recorded when a rate update is requested.
Timestamp recorded when the oracle callback is executed.
Requested price in wei, set by setPrice and read by getPrice.
Block timestamp (now) used for updateTime and callbackTime.
Constant oracle name string stored as bytes32.
Constant oracle type string stored as bytes16.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before executing guarded code.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership execution.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into the owner state variable, altering privileged access.
bank parameter flows into setBank.
setBank writes the bank parameter into bankAddress, which gates updateRate.
updater parameter flows into setUpdaterAddress.
setUpdaterAddress writes the updater parameter into updaterAddress, which authenticates callbacks and receives funds.
_requestPriceWei parameter flows into setPrice.
setPrice writes the parameter into requestPrice, which controls fund withdrawals.
onlyBank modifier requires msg.sender == bankAddress before updateRate runs.
msg.sender is compared against bankAddress to authorise updateRate.
updateRate stores block.timestamp (now) into updateTime, creating timestamp dependency.
updateRate sets waitQuery to true.
__callback requires msg.sender == updaterAddress to accept the rate update.
updaterAddress is the required caller identity in the __callback guard.
result parameter flows into __callback.
__callback writes the result parameter into the rate state variable.
__callback stores block.timestamp (now) into callbackTime, creating timestamp dependency.
__callback resets waitQuery to false.
Fallback function executes the external value transfer unsafe operation.
Unsafe transfer sends msg.value to updaterAddress, an externally controlled destination.
External transfer can re-enter the payable fallback before state changes complete.
getPrice reads updaterAddress.balance to decide the returned price.
getPrice reads requestPrice when comparing balances.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used as the input written into the owner state variable by transferOwnership.
bank is only used as the input written into bankAddress by setBank.
updater is only used as the input written into updaterAddress by setUpdaterAddress.
_requestPriceWei is only used as the input written into requestPrice by setPrice.
result is only used as the callback payload written into rate by __callback.
